rationale: dst_data captures the src_clk-bound input src_data under c2, the qualifier synchronised from the src_clk register load. That qualifies the capture structurally, but no contract gives how long the payload is held, how far apart loads are, or any acknowledgment. Payload stability around capture cannot be decided.
caveats: CDC-039 is a primary input under a recognised same-launch qualifier and keeps the source-stability obligation (WARNING Heuristic). It is allowed to disclose an unknown.

CDC-013(a) will probably fire on load to c1 (10 ns to 14 ns, a direct copy that is not monotonic). That is the related unspecified load rate, not the labelled payload-stability site, so it is not added, to avoid widening.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
